description: Search AgendaForge's public website and documentation (features, pricing, integrations, guides, API and MCP docs) by keyword. Use it to answer product questions or to find a page to read with fetch_doc; it never touches account or private event data. Returns results[] ranked best first with title, description, url, markdownUrl, snippet, and score.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return.

query.description: Words or a natural language phrase to search for.

name: search_docs

markdownUrl.description: Markdown URL; pass it to fetch_doc.
